kpis.description_fr: Accelera = nouveau segment zero-emission (hydrogen, battery electric, fuel cells). Croissance forte mais petit. Investissement long terme.
kpis.description_en: Accelera = new zero-emission segment (hydrogen, battery electric, fuel cells). Strong growth but small. Long-term investment.

kpis.description_fr: Backlog ~5,5 Mds $, dont gros volume Power Systems data center. Visibilité 6-12 mois.
kpis.description_en: Backlog ~$5.5B, including significant Power Systems data center volume. 6-12 month visibility.

kpis.signal: Plus gros segment external Cummins, services apres-vente recurrents, croissance 5/5 ans
kpis.description_fr: Ventes externes du segment Distribution (pieces detachees, services, groupes electrogenes, location). Annuite recurrente services apres-vente, plus gros segment a destination clients externes.
kpis.description_en: Distribution segment external sales (parts, service, gensets, rental). Recurring aftermarket annuity, largest external-customer segment.

kpis.signal: Baisse FY24 liee a cession 80.5% Atmus (mars 2024) + faiblesse marche heavy-duty truck
kpis.description_fr: Ventes externes du segment Components (apres-traitement, turbos, fuel systems, transmissions Meritor). Baisse FY24 mecaniquement liee a la cession de 80.5% d'Atmus Filtration en mars 2024.
kpis.description_en: Components segment external sales (aftertreatment, turbos, fuel systems, Meritor transmissions). FY24 decline mechanically due to March 2024 divestiture of remaining 80.5% Atmus Filtration stake.

kpis.signal: Marque historique Cummins, expose cycle heavy/medium duty truck Amerique du Nord
kpis.description_fr: Ventes externes du segment Engine (moteurs diesel et gaz naturel pour camions lourds/moyens, autobus, off-highway). Marque historique, expose cycle truck Amerique du Nord et Chine.
kpis.description_en: Engine segment external sales (diesel and natural-gas engines for heavy/medium-duty trucks, bus, off-highway). Historical brand, exposed to North American and China truck cycle.

kpis.signal: Hypercroissance portee par boom data centers (groupes electrogenes haute puissance)
kpis.description_fr: Ventes externes du segment Power Systems (gros moteurs >19L, groupes electrogenes haute puissance pour data centers, mining, marine). Beneficiaire direct du boom infrastructure IA.
kpis.description_en: Power Systems external sales (large engines >19L, high-horsepower gensets for data centers, mining, marine). Direct beneficiary of AI infrastructure buildout.

kpis.signal: Pari zero emission Cummins (electrolyseurs hydrogene, batteries, fuel cells). Encore en perte mais x5 sur 5 ans
kpis.description_fr: Ventes externes Accelera (renomme New Power debut 2023) : electrolyseurs hydrogene, packs batteries, fuel cells, e-axles. Pari long terme zero emission, encore en perte operationnelle.
kpis.description_en: Accelera (renamed from New Power in early 2023) external sales: hydrogen electrolyzers, battery packs, fuel cells, e-axles. Long-term zero-emission bet, still operating at a loss.

kpis.signal: Plateau 2024 du a cession Atmus (~1.6Mds$ d'impact) mais Power Systems et Distribution compensent
kpis.description_fr: Chiffre d'affaires net consolide Cummins. FY24 stable malgre impact ~1.6Mds$ de la cession Atmus, croissance organique soutenue Distribution et Power Systems.
kpis.description_en: Cummins consolidated net sales. FY24 flat despite ~$1.6B Atmus divestiture impact, organic growth strong in Distribution and Power Systems.
